items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: That was Tom... That's Tom King's building. You know, Tom King's sheriff around here.

ctx.x: That was Tom... That's Tom King's building. You know, Tom King's sheriff around here. Not the sheriff. Yeah, he was the sheriff. He was the sheriff.
No, I didn't know him. That was a little before my time. Professor Mineta used to tell me about all those people and places and all that.
